### Restoring the Richness of Marriage in Today's Hook-Up Culture
Author: Peyton Garland  
Site: Crosswalk.com  
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-couples-devotional/restoring-the-richness-of-marriage-in-todays-hook-up-culture.html  
Passage: Song of Solomon 7:10  
Points:
- Genuine romantic connection requires both God-designed physical attraction and God-aligned spiritual priorities.
- Modern hookup culture should be countered by cultivating deep conversation, emotional bonding, and shared values.
- Healthy Christian marriages require physical attraction, which God purposefully designed and affirmed in Scripture.
- Biblical modesty balances character, confidence, and mystery while honoring the chemistry between husband and wife.
- Spouses should examine media influences and actively foster both emotional and physical intimacy in their marriage.
